description: This Java class, PaymentDBUtil, provides database utility methods for handling payment-related operations such as retrieving, inserting, updating, and deleting payment records in the database, as well as creating a new payment and obtaining its ID.
external_files: webDB (assumed to be a database utility class)

classes.name: PaymentDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class for database operations related to payments

methods.name: getAllPayment
methods.description: Retrieves all payment records from the database

methods.name: insertPayment
methods.description: Inserts a new payment record into the database

methods.name: updatePayment
methods.description: Updates an existing payment record identified by PID

methods.name: deletePayment
methods.description: Deletes a payment record identified by PID

methods.name: createPayment
methods.description: Creates a new payment entry and returns the generated payment ID
